title: D-045 B2 research: street-width / mapped-street official-source research (A2 dependency; connector research-first discipline)
objective: Identify and evidence the authoritative official NYC source(s) for street width and mapped-street status per street segment/frontage - the data input the A2 geometry-dependent rule mechanics need (street-width-dependent height limits; the existing R6-R8 wide-street conditional rule's 75-ft class of thresholds). Research-first per the connector discipline: official publisher and dataset/API identification with evidence (never guessed schemas/fields/units); field semantics incl. WHICH width the source records (mapped street width vs roadbed vs curb-to-curb) and how that maps onto the ZR's street-width concepts; access method, auth posture, rate limits, update cadence, licensing; recorded-official capture feasibility for a thin client (small verbatim sample captures documented by URL+timestamp+hash procedure, no bulk datasets); honest limitations and conflict surfaces (e.g. Geoclient per-address streetWidth/streetWidthMaximum fields recorded in M2-T021 as a candidate - compare authority, granularity, and semantics against segment-level sources such as DCP's Digital City Map / street centerline products); a source-registry draft per the M2-T009 posture. NO connector code in this task - research + registry draft only; the connector build is a later packet citing this research.
business_reason: D-045-R003 names the B2 street-width connector as the A2 dependency and mandates official-source research FIRST; running it now (parallel with M4-T012 under D-046) pulls the A2 wave's critical path forward with fully disjoint scope.

acceptance_scenarios.expected: the official publisher(s) and exact dataset/API for street width and mapped-street status are identified with evidence (live URLs, retrieval dates, official documentation quotes); access method and auth posture stated from the source's own docs; nothing guessed (permanent principle 3)

for each candidate the report states WHICH width concept the field records (mapped/record width vs roadbed vs curb-to-curb), its units, and how it maps onto the ZR street-width thresholds the rules layer consumes (the existing R6-R8 wide-street rule named as the consumer); ambiguities recorded as open questions, never resolved by assumption

a documented, re-runnable recorded-official capture procedure (exact query URLs, expected response shape from evidence, timestamp+hash recording) sized for the thin client (small verbatim samples, no bulk downloads); keyless vs keyed stated; any key requirement routed to the owner boundary, never acquired in-task

Geoclient per-address streetWidth/streetWidthMaximum (recorded in M2-T021 fixtures) compared against segment-level official sources on authority, granularity, semantics, and failure modes; disagreement surfaces named; the recommendation states its tradeoffs instead of hiding them

draft(s) follow the M2-T009 structure (source id, publisher, endpoint, cadence, licensing, limitations) consistent with the research report; draft status clearly non-final; no invented registry mechanism
zero code changes: only the research report + registry draft(s); no connector, no fixtures, no dependency, no schema touched (the connector build is a later packet that pins this report)

risks: the term 'street width' is overloaded across NYC sources (DCM mapped width, CSCL physical attributes, Geoclient per-address values) - the report must keep the concepts separate; conflating them would poison the A2 rule mechanics downstream

the ZR's own street/street-line definitions govern which measurement the rules need; if the official data's concept does not match the ZR concept, that mismatch is THE finding, not something to paper over
web sources may be slow/unavailable; record retrieval failures honestly and mark affected sections open rather than substituting memory
licensing/terms for bulk products may differ from per-query APIs - state both; thin client forbids bulk mirrors regardless
